newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 to discuss supervision, economy - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: G10 to discuss supervision, economy - Tietmeyer.

text.p: The Group of 10 (G10) central bank governors will discuss work by the Basle Committee on Banking Supervision and the worldwide economic situation at their regular monthly meeting, Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said.
Tietmeyer, who chairs the central bank governors committee, said he would brief reporters after the meeting in early afternoon.
He spoke briefly to reporters as he was entering the Bank for International Settlements building.
Federal Reserve Board chairman Alan Greenspan is also attending the meeting, but he made no comments.
Banking supervisors are considering some kind of global banking standards aimed at preventing financial crises in the next century. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
